ppk: PPK is a Marxist-Leninist terrorist group of Kurds trying to establish an independent Kurdish state in eastern Turkey.
PPK means the same as Kurdistan Workers Party or Kurdistan Labor Pary or Partiya Karkeran Kurdistan.
pplo: PPLO is a mycoplasma resistant to antibiotics that causes a kind of pneumonia in humans.
PPLO means the same as pleuropneumonialike organism.
ppp: PPP is surgical resection of unnecessary palatal and oropharyngeal tissue to open the airway.
PPP means the same as palatopharyngoplasty or uvulopalatopharyngoplasty or UPPP.
